signals.text: 3 open PM roles across 3 US offices
1 new PM role posted this week

roles.title: Director of Product, Mission Solutions
roles.location: Arlington, Virginia, United States; Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States; Remote; San Francisco, California, United States

bullets: Define a product strategy for your mission area that connects directly to how customers reach readiness, and to how Air wins and keeps accounts.
Make the portfolio-level trade-offs within your area so individual bets add up to one coherent solution, not a pile of features.
Reframe the mission problem rather than servicing the requests in front of you, and set the principles that guide decisions across your team.
Own measurable outcomes - adoption, expansion, and the readiness metrics that matter in your domain - and report them at the leadership level.

roles.title: Principal Product Manager - AI/ML
roles.location: Arlington, Virginia, United States; Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States; Remote; San Francisco, California, United States

bullets: Spend time on site with users, seeking to understand their pain points and triangulate the commonalities where AI/ML can automate manual processes, enhance decision-making, or…
Write detailed product requirements documents (PRDs) and user stories for AI/ML features
Collaborate with data science and AI/ML engineering teams to assess the feasibility of proposed solutions
Partner with designers and Application PMs to integrate AI/ML capabilities seamlessly into existing Air workflows, ensuring models enhance rather than disrupt user experiences
Work with the sales team to articulate the value proposition of AI/ML features to prospective customers and understand market demand for intelligent automation

roles.title: Principal Product Manager - Builder Experiences
roles.location: Arlington, Virginia, United States; Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, United States

bullets: Spend several days on site with users (internal and external), seeking to understand how users across a variety of accounts utilize Air Enterprise Readiness platform to relieve…
Draft clear and compelling articulation of customer problems, and what a good solution to those problems would look like in the Air Enterprise Readiness platform.
Partner with the other PMs and go-to-market team to help assess opportunities and understand the degree to which customer requirements align with product capabilities and roadmap
Define how those solutions deliver value across a wide range of customer environments and determine what features are necessary to support broad adoption of the solution.
Collaborate with engineering and design teams to deliver the most promising capabilities.
